## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Chore (updates, documentation, linting, etc.)

## Pre-Flight Checklist

Please check all applicable items.

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (ESLint / Prettier).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] My changes generate zero warnings (e.g., React hydration or PropType warnings).
- [ ] I have checked my changes locally across different screen sizes (Mobile / Desktop).
- [ ] The code compiles without TypeScript errors (`npx tsc --noEmit`).
